Rasterise the most-recent stand-replacing disturbance to the rasterToMatch

Source: R/fire_data.R
calc_recently_disturbed.Rd

Rasterises the most-recent stand-replacing disturbance (since recent_year) to the rasterToMatch. MRSRD_Y = year of the most recent stand-replacing disturbance; MRSRD_A = its cause (CUT or BRN).

Usage

calc_recently_disturbed(for_dist, rtm, recent_year)

Arguments

for_dist

sf or SpatVector of forest-disturbance polygons carrying MRSRD_Y and MRSRD_A columns.

rtm

A rasterToMatch SpatRaster.

recent_year

Integer cutoff year; only disturbances after it are kept.

Value

A SpatRaster of the most-recent disturbance year, aligned to rtm.
